mask_colors.comment: RGB values matching your hand-drawn masks

training.comment: Random Forest hyperparameters. More trees = slower but more stable. Deeper trees capture finer detail but risk overfitting.

features.comment: Smaller scales (e.g. [1, 2, 4]) preserve small granule edges better. Larger scales smooth them out. entropy_radii control texture detection — smaller values detect finer texture.

postprocessing.comment: CRITICAL for small granules: reduce these values to keep small objects. min_object_size removes objects smaller than this many pixels. Set to 0 to keep everything. smooth_radius is the mode filter radius — smaller = less smoothing = better small feature retention. closing_radius smooths boundaries — 0 disables.
